**Finding: Deviation (WARRANTY — Performance warranty and duration)**

Article VIX is a pure "AS IS" disclaimer that negates all warranties, express *and* implied, and specifically disclaims any assurance that errors or nonconformities to the Documentation will be corrected. The only adjacent Vendor obligation — "commercially reasonable efforts to provide Error Corrections" (p0093) — is not a warranty and carries no remedy, and is undercut by the disclaimer. This is the playbook's walk-away position, so it fails the fallback.

Redline (validated, ok:true):
- p0110/p0111: carve express warranties out of the disclaimer and limit it to *other implied* warranties.
- New paragraph after p0116: 12-month documentation/specification conformance warranty, professional and workmanlike performance, compliance with laws, no malicious code, with repair/replace and a refund backstop if not cured within 30 days.
- Fallback offered in the comment: 90 days software / 30 days services with the same remedies.
